basics.summary: PhD candidate in Mathematics at Syracuse University (advisor: Graham J. Leuschke) working in commutative algebra, with a focus on maximal Cohen–Macaulay modules over Cohen–Macaulay rings. Experienced instructor of record across multiple calculus sequences; designs lectures, assessments, and student-centered course materials.
